issues.description: The problem statement specifies that SealSaloon should have a modifiable List<Meal> orders attribute (and UML also notes orders as a List), but the provided solution implements orders as a Meal[] array. This mismatch between the described attribute type (List) and the actual implementation (array) can confuse students: they may implement a List<Meal> as instructed and find helper utilities and the reference implementation using arrays, leading to test/compatibility issues.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification and the implementation consistent. Either (A) update problem_statement.md and the UML to request a modifiable Meal[] orders (and mention ArrayHelpers usage), or (B) change the solution (and any helper code/tests) to use a java.util.List<Meal> for orders (and adjust ArrayHelpers/usages accordingly). Ensure the example code and any guidance consistently reference the same type.
